extractions.value: Patient developed diplopia four months after onset of stiffness, with eye movement abnormalities suggestive of ocular myasthenia gravis. Anti-AChR antibodies were negative at presentation but became positive one year after onset, one month after thymectomy. Thymoma was detected by CT and confirmed histologically. This is the first report of abnormalities on eye movement recordings strongly suggesting myasthenia gravis in SPS before the patient became seropositive for anti-AChR antibodies.
